main.description: The consenting half, in the WEARER's own repo: 'I wear the flair `def` issued by `issuer`.' The record key MUST be '<issuer>:<def>' (one badge per flair, idempotent writes). Self-asserted — display requires the def to exist and, for policy 'granted', a matching at.tessera.flair.grant in the issuer's repo. Never render a wear nobody's counterpart confirms. A record whose key and fields disagree is invalid, not a wear. DIDs containing characters outside the record-key charset (e.g. percent-encoded did:web forms) cannot be represented in this key and thus cannot be referenced by a badge.

name.description: The def's name at the time of consent. When present, consumers MUST treat a mismatch with the def's current name as not-a-wear (fail closed): a renamed flair is a new statement the wearer has not agreed to. Absent on badges written before this field existed — those verify against the live name.
